title: Read the first publication on the MSK-KP
summary: A paper on the Musculoskeletal Knowledge Portal was published today in the Journal of Bone and Mineral Research.
bodyHtml:
A paper on the Musculoskeletal Knowledge Portal was published today in the Journal of Bone and Mineral Research. "The Musculoskeletal Knowledge Portal: Making Omics Data Useful to the Broader Scientific Community" (Kiel et al., 2020) describes the evolution of the MSK-KP project and the goals of the MSK-KP. An accompanying editorial by Fernando Rivadeneira and Jennifer Westendorf highlights the value that data sharing in the MSK-KP will bring to the musculoskeletal research community.

The MSK-KP is under continuous development. We welcome your comments and suggestions!
